svg.title: opentone power distribution tree
svg.desc: Power distribution of the opentone test board: USB-C and the LiPo cell feed VSYS through the MCP73831 charger and D7/Q1 load sharing; VSYS feeds the TPS63802 buck-boost (+3.3V), the TPS7A20 LDO pair (+1V8 and +3.3VA for the VS1053b) and the DRV2605L; the +3.3V rail feeds the MCU, memory, Bluetooth, panels, backlights, click wheel and the planned CS43131, each with its drain jumper and enable signal.
svg.text: JP501 · same rail as I2C1 pull-ups
JP202 / JP302: +3.3V or VSYS · PWM sink
AP2112K 1.8 V · DAC_EN · VP from VSYS
